candidate.note: v0.6.2 hotfix release candidate: thirteen defects an external code review of 0.6.0-0.6.1 reported, landed as PR #81 (memory-tier corruption) and PR #82 (sync and recovery), plus the version bump and changelog. No UI layout change beyond lock ordering in ui/lib/core.cjs, and no search or injection scoring change. Gates followed the same list docs/VERIFICATION.md §2 documents at this SHA as v0.6.1 did — the widened `node --test test/*.test.mjs` glob, bracketed by the read-only real-root isolation check §4 requires — and that list is unchanged in this release; only the §3 acceptance-map rows were extended to name the new regressions. `git status --porcelain` was empty before the gates and HEAD was unchanged after, and `npm run build` reproduced the tracked dist/ byte-for-byte. The tarball holds 327 files, the same as v0.6.1, and adding merge-gate-pre-0.6.2.json left it at 327. Only receipt files change afterwards. No push, tag, release or installed-plugin update is performed by this receipt.

reviewRemediation.source: An external code review of v0.5.2..v0.6.1 by Codex gpt-6-astra at low reasoning effort, which raised 22 findings numbered #59 to #80. An independent verification pass confirmed every finding either fully or partially, and 19 of them were reproduced against the code.
reviewRemediation.reviewScope: The review read the diff between the two releases; it is not a whole-codebase audit, and its confirmation pass was run by this project rather than by an outside party.

fixedHere.verifiedFromChangelog: The 0.6.2 changelog body cites exactly these thirteen issue numbers. Its header also writes the range (#59-#80), which is the review's extent, not a claim that #80 was fixed.

reviewRemediation.regressions: Every fix carries a regression that reproduces the reported state: test/fact-tier-ladder.test.ts and test/continuity-identity tests for the tier-corruption set, ui/test/core.cjs for the lock ordering (#76), test/sync-tier-import.test.ts for inactive history rows not counting as an active slot conflict and for reaching same-generation tombstones (#66), test/sync-control.test.ts for a changed shared folder not skipping the first export and for the recall-receipt prepared-to-emitted transition moving the export fingerprint (#68/#67), test/maintenance-wave-lineage.test.ts for run-id splitting and a failed UNIQUE index not blocking DB open (#72), test/capsule-retry-convergence.test.ts for a transient failure leaving the frontier intact and recover rewinding it (#71), and test/job-recovery.test.ts for refusing the target path of an owned job holding a live lease with no partial reset under CAS contention (#70).

deferredTo063.note: These nine review findings are not addressed in this release. 13 fixed plus 9 deferred accounts for all 22 findings.

carriedForwardBoundaries.crossDeviceSync: Sync still ships OFF on protocol v5 with tier-preserving import, and 0.6.2 corrects four sync and recovery defects in it.
carriedForwardBoundaries.ontologyMaintenance: The 0.6.1 ontology parking, UNIQUE merge migration, wave lineage, derived-lane skip and receipt backfill work is unchanged except for the wave run-id fix (#72).

reviewRemediation.liveTwoDeviceRoundTrip: NOT_PROVEN: the sync fixes were exercised in isolated fixtures on one host. No export was carried to a second machine and imported there, so the defects #66, #67 and #68 are proven fixed against reproduced states, not against a real two-device round trip.
reviewRemediation.liveTierRepair: NOT_PROVEN: whether any tier corruption already written to the user's real root is repaired by these fixes was not checked. The gates prove new writes follow the corrected rules on fixtures.
reviewRemediation.reviewClosure: NOT_PROVEN: that the 13 fixes fully resolve what the review described is this project's own verification, not the reviewer's re-confirmation. The three findings confirmed only partially are not separately identified in this receipt.

realRootIsolation.mode: read-only; snapshot before the gates, compare after, as docs/VERIFICATION.md §4 now requires
realRootIsolation.volatileExclusions: run-locks/ and unix sockets are excluded by default because they exist only while something is running; --strict was not used.
realRootIsolation.motivation: 0.5.0 QA found test/web-ui-db-factory.test.mjs isolating only MEMEX_DB_PATH and appending 21 lines to the real logs/ui-audit.jsonl. That suite is now inside the widened mjs gate, and this run leaves the real root byte-identical.
realRootIsolation.caveat: This proves the gate run did not write to the root, not that the root is healthy. Judgement is by content hash, so a read-only access that only moves atime is correctly not a failure.

releaseConclusion: Every gate in the list docs/VERIFICATION.md §2 documents at this SHA passes on the clean v0.6.2 candidate 0f4ccc82, each on its first attempt: the real-root snapshot, typecheck, a build that reproduced the tracked dist/, 117 files / 1156 Vitest tests, 162 tests through the widened mjs glob, installer, marketplace, packaged runtime (memex-0.6.2.tgz, 327 files, 9 MCP tools), offline lifecycle 9/9 with 13 owned hook entries, 134 Workspace unit tests, 19 real-Chrome Workspace probes with 0 runtime errors, isolated plugin validation, the benchmark contract, the pack dry-run and the closing real-root comparison, which reports 106 files compared with 0 added, 0 removed and 0 modified. The gate list itself is unchanged from v0.6.1; only the §3 acceptance-map rows were extended to name the new regressions. This is a hotfix for an external review of 0.6.0-0.6.1 that raised 22 findings: 13 are fixed here across PR #81 for memory-tier corruption and PR #82 for sync and recovery, each with a regression that reproduces the reported state, and 9 are explicitly deferred to 0.6.3. The changelog's header range (#59-#80) describes the review's extent, not its fix list, which cites exactly the 13. The tarball stayed at 327 files and the new archive did not inflate it. The benchmark was not re-run for a second release and is carried forward from the v0.6.0 candidate, so benchmarkOnThisSha is NOT_PROVEN. The live injection-yield confirmation from v0.6.0 is cited as prior live evidence only; because the tier code it depends on changed in 0.6.1 and again here, it does not carry to this release and is due a fresh post-release check. A live two-device sync round trip, repair of any tier corruption already written to the user's real root, the reviewer's own re-confirmation of these fixes, live tier placement and migration, an authenticated Codex tier run, the formal plugin validator, real-world performance at production corpus sizes and model quality remain NOT_PROVEN.
